question: Does the public Pasac-Guagua watershed map or project boundary record provide a reusable, coordinate-resolved polygon for the watershed and clarify which administrative scope is adopted?

publishedMap.mapPreparedBy: Province of Pampanga; Provincial Government Environment and Natural Resources Office (PG-ENRO)
publishedMap.limit: The reviewed publication contains a rendered map, not source coordinates, a Shapefile/GeoPackage/GeoJSON, a metadata date for the boundary, or the GIS processing method. The printed projection label is not a complete datum/CRS definition. No map image or polygon has been copied or traced into this repository.

projectAdoptedBoundaryScope.basis: The 2024 IRBM project newsletters report agreement with DENR Region III and Pampanga PG-ENRO to use the Pasac Watershed boundary in the 2017-2021 Area-based Management Plan for project scope.
projectAdoptedBoundaryScope.limit: The newsletters summarize the adopted ABMP boundary and municipality coverage but do not include the original ABMP map or polygon in the reviewed items. They do not establish whether the site-profile map depicts the same boundary version or whether its other two partially intersected municipalities are outside the ABMP extent.

queries: Pasac Watershed GIS shapefile boundary Pampanga
Pasac Watershed Geoportal Philippines map boundary
Area-based Management Plan of Pasac Watershed 2017 2021 PDF
publicVectorSearch.result: The searches surfaced the PEMSEA rendered map/profile and boundary-adoption accounts, but no public downloadable source polygon or GIS package for the adopted Pasac Watershed boundary.
publicVectorSearch.limit: This is a bounded public-web search result, not proof that no GIS file exists elsewhere or is available on request.

assessment.mapValue: The Pampanga-prepared map is useful as attributed basin-level reference evidence and gives a stated area and projection label. It can guide source discovery and internal visual comparison.
assessment.scopeReconciliation: The profile describes ten municipalities as partially within the watershed, while the 2024 project-adoption accounts name eight municipalities under the ABMP boundary. The records do not provide enough version detail to call these extents identical or contradictory; keep both scope statements with their source and date.
assessment.channelRelationship: A watershed polygon and its internal waterways do not resolve the exact Pasac/Pasak channel reach or establish a local spelling alias. Keep the separate reach-level name crosswalk unresolved.
assessment.geometryStatus: No coordinate-resolved watershed polygon or river-channel line was added. The PDF map is not treated as importable GIS geometry.

conclusion.summary: A 2024 PEMSEA profile publishes a Pampanga PG-ENRO-prepared map depicting the Pasac-Guagua watershed boundary and waterways, with a stated area of 42,570.86 hectares and a UTM Zone 51N/Luzon Datum label. Separate 2024 project newsletters report adoption of the 2017-2021 ABMP Pasac Watershed boundary for project scope across eight municipalities. The profile's ten-municipality partial-intersection description is not enough to confirm that the two products use the same boundary version. No reusable vector or precise channel geometry was found in the reviewed public materials. Keep the map as research reference only; do not trace it into public app geometry or infer Pasac/Pasak reach identity from it.
whatWouldResolveIt: A public or otherwise reviewable GIS export of the adopted ABMP Pasac Watershed boundary, with publication date, full CRS/datum, lineage, and item-level reuse terms.
The original ABMP 2017-2021 map or GIS source and a direct comparison with the PG-ENRO map in the 2024 PEMSEA profile.
For channel-level identity, a dated hydrographic line layer or reach-level official map that ties the source-reported Pasac/Pasak names to coordinates; a basin polygon alone is insufficient.

If no vector is publicly released, a separately versioned DEM/hydrography-derived candidate boundary can be built for internal research, checked against the published map and open hydrography, and labeled approximate/model-derived rather than authoritative.

nextActions: Keep the published map and eight-municipality project scope as separate, attributed research records until the original ABMP boundary can be compared with the PG-ENRO map.
Continue Central Luzon waterbody and fish-source research without treating the watershed map as a species record, river line, or app boundary.
Only consider a model-derived candidate boundary as an internal, explicitly approximate research artifact; do not publish it as official or exact.

sources.supports: 2024 profile and map prepared by Pampanga PG-ENRO: depicted watershed boundary/waterways, 42,570.86 hectares, UTM Zone 51N/Luzon Datum map label, and ten municipalities described as partially within the watershed.
PEMSEA's account of the agreement with DENR Region III and Pampanga PG-ENRO to adopt the Pasac Watershed ABMP 2017-2021 boundary for IRBM scope, naming eight municipalities.
PEMSEA's report of the 21 June 2024 Region III Subcommittee on Environment meeting and project adoption of Pasac Watershed boundaries based on the ABMP.
